'''AC-38''', nicknamed '''Ace''' or '''Ace-38''',<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Travel Agency|altlink=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=1021}}</ref> was an [[AC series pilot droid]] that worked for [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] as a pilot<ref name="ST:AC" /> sometime between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ST2 date">According to [[Star Wars Insider 127|''Star Wars Insider'' 127]], ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. In the attraction's queue, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] refers to the secret base of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. According to [[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'']], the Rebels only acquired the key to the Great Temple in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The attraction must therefore take place after that.</ref> During one flight, Ace was the intended pilot and was supposed to fly passengers in a [[StarSpeeder 1000]]. 

During the last minute, when the [[Binary motivator]] malfunctioned in the ''StarSpeeder 1000'', AC-38 hired [[Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to fix the motivator. AC-38 exit the ship to inspect the front of the ship while C-3PO was supposed to ensure the onboard consoles were in working order and fix the motivator. However, C-3PO inadvertently trapped himself within the cockpit via the autopilot itself is suddenly triggered who seals the cockpit shield inside. Outside, while AC-38 is inspecting the front of the chip, he got distracted with something else (someone called him to check something else), failing to report back when the autopilot's preparations were complete as he walk away from the ship. When the ship was elevated to the loading area, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was in the pilot's seat instead as he was force to pilot the ship by the autopilot.<ref name="sw-unveal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/startours_droids/index.html|text=Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids}}</ref><ref name="disney-3po">{{DPB|url=2010/10/whos-flying-this-thing|text=Who's Flying This Thing?!}}</ref> In an advertisement for the StarSpeeder, [[Aly San San/Legends|Aly San San]] described Ace as friendly and personable, but he can be a bit testy at times, as shown when Ace tells Threepio to make his work quick because they were scheduled to depart in several minutes.<ref name="ST:AC" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The initial concept of [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|''Star Tours II'']] called for the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] to be piloted by Ace. But on a blog post by Tom Fitzgerald, the Executive VP & Senior Creative Executive of Walt Disney Imagineering, it was revealed that the actual and true pilot would be C-3PO and Ace's job would be taken over by him.<ref name="sw-unveal" /><ref name="disney-3po" /> When Ace was planned to be the pilot, he was to be voiced by Patrick Warburton,<ref>[[D23 Expo 2011: The Making Of Star Tours]]</ref> though he would be recast with actor Lindsay Schnebly when the character's role was reduced.<ref>{{EndorExpress|url=special-features/2011-d23-expo-tom-fitzgerald-interview|text=More with Tom Fitzgerald on Star Tours: The Adventures Continues}}</ref> The circumstances behind 3PO taking over Ace's job were explained in the preparations video for the Star Tours ride, before the ride underwent boarding procedures.<ref name="ST:AC" />
